bout-main.html:
Danilo Reyes vs. Artem Volkov

Round 1

Reyes takes the center in a southpaw stance and immediately works his lead hand. Volkov circles outside, but Reyes catches him with a straight left and follows with a hard kick to the body.

Volkov answers with a right hand in the final minute, only for Reyes to close the round with a clean three-punch combination along the fence.

Sherdog scores the round 10-9 Reyes.

Round 2

Du Plessis controls the range with kicks and stuns Usman with a staggered one-two combination. Du Plessis later rocks Usman badly with a stance switch and multiple head kicks. Usman survives and rallies with heavy right hands, forcing a takedown attempt and landing a late barrage of punches. Both fighters trade offense in a competitive final round.

Sherdog scores the round 10-9 Volkov.

bout-comain.html:
Marisol Castillo vs. Adaeze Okafor

Round 1

Castillo presses forward behind compact combinations, landing a right hand before Okafor ties her up against the fence. Okafor reverses position and scores a takedown, but Castillo is back on her feet before the final minute.

Castillo finishes the round with two crisp left hooks and a kick to the ribs as Okafor circles away.

Sherdog scores the round 10-9 Castillo.

Round 2

Okafor switches stances and draws Castillo into a level change. She sprawls, spins to the back and secures both hooks while Castillo tries to stand.

Okafor slips her forearm under the chin and tightens the rear-naked choke. Castillo taps at 3:17 of the second round, completing the comeback.

Sherdog scores the round 10-9 Okafor.

bout-5.html:
Petr Novak vs. Manaia Tuivasa

Round 1

Tuivasa opens with a low kick, but Novak steps through it and lands a short right hand. The heavyweights trade in the pocket, where Novak connects with a left hook that buckles Tuivasa.

Novak follows with two unanswered punches against the fence, and the referee waves off the bout just 48 seconds into the opening round.

Sherdog scores the round 10-9 Novak.
